summons.label: General's War Banner
_curatorNotes: `terminatesOn: 'burst'` (summon-ends-on-cast round, 2026-09-19): "If a General's War Banner created by Gorou currently exists on the field when this ability is used, it will be destroyed" — the burst's own text.

Banner buffs authored at talent level 10: Standing Firm = flat 371 DEF (sidecar 'DEF Increase' row, col 10; flat number, not %). Tiers gate by Geo party count INCLUDING Gorou, but teamElementCount counts non-holder members only — so 1-Geo tier is unconditional, Impregnable (2 Geo) gates on >=1 non-Gorou Geo, Crunch (3 Geo, +15% Geo DMG) on >=2.

Buffs apply to the ACTIVE character within the banner AoE (kit text; target: 'active'). The in-game 2s buff linger after the active character leaves the field is not modeled — buff windows run the banner's 10s lifetime.

Snapshot: KQM TCL — banner DEF/Geo-DMG buffs snapshot with abilities cast under them (snapshottable: true). interruptionRes is a unitless presence window (value: unknown per convention), snapshottable: false.
Hold variant only adjusts placement position; gcsim has no separate hold-variant frame data for this skill — single skillFrames array used for both Tap and Hold.

General's War Banner terminatesOn is non-standard: the banner is explicitly destroyed when Q is cast (gcsim: Status.Delete on burstHitmark=31). Also, E will not create a new banner while General's Glory is active. Standard terminatesOn 'recast' does not capture this cross-ability interaction — reviewer to decide schema approach.

↻ THE BUFFS ARE AUTHORED AT THEIR HONEST LENGTH, 2026-09-21 (summon-bound buffs round): field + 2s, so 12s on the banner's 10 and 11s on the Glory's 9 — the Bennett (12s field / 14.1s buff) and Faruzan house form, which CLAUDE.md already states and which Gorou belongs to. gcsim skill.go:95-128 is a 0.3s re-application loop handing the active character a TWO-SECOND stat mod and returning only when BOTH fields are down, so the last tick's mod outlives the field that queued it; measured, the chain ends at 754f on a `Gorou E` whose banner ends at 634f. ⚓⚓ It also retires the note above's "the in-game 2s buff linger is not modeled". ⛔ AND IT IS WHY THE BUFF IS NOT BOUND TO THE BANNER'S WINDOW: the loop accepts EITHER field, so cutting the E's bar when the burst destroys the banner would be a new wrong answer — `Gorou E ~3s Q` is ONE continuous buff in game, and at these lengths the two bars cover 34-754 and 257-917 with no gap and no instant either of them claims falsely. A span-bound primitive would only re-attribute the overlap, which is why it was scoped out rather than built.
abilities.description:
Deals AoE Geo DMG and sets up a General's War Banner.

General's War Banner
Provides up to 3 buffs to active characters within the skill's AoE based on the number of Geo characters in the party at the time of casting:
· 1 Geo character: Adds "Standing Firm" - DEF Bonus.
· 2 Geo characters: Adds "Impregnable" - Increased resistance to interruption.
· 3 Geo characters: Adds "Crunch" - Geo DMG Bonus.

Gorou can deploy only 1 General's War Banner on the field at any one time. Characters can only benefit from 1 General's War Banner at a time. When a party member leaves the field, the active buff will last for 2s.

Hold
Adjust the location of the skill.
abilities.caveat: With only the War Banner out, the buff reaches whoever is standing inside it; the bar shows it for the whole party's active character wherever they go. Under General's Glory the field follows you, so there is nothing to stand in.

abilities.name: Juuga: Forward Unto Victory

_curatorNotes: C4 Lapping Hound (2026-09-17, T1.5; was a `manual` heal on the C4 entry that reached nothing). gcsim burst.go: at C4 with geoCharCount > 1 (Impregnable or Crunch) gorouBurstHealField heals the ACTIVE character for 50% of Gorou's DEF (snapshotted at the burst), first at 90f and every 90f while General's Glory lives — the Crystal Collapse cadence exactly. teamElementCount excludes the holder, so `geo >= 1` is 'a second Geo member'.
⚠️ Same cadence as the damage series, so the lane draws two markers per tick — the open L5e duplicate-marker class (damage + heal on one cadence). No tickCap to mirror: the damage series has none.

General's Glory recreates the same three banner buffs as E (identical tier gating; talent level 10 values shared — the DEF Increase / Geo DMG Bonus rows live on the SKILL talent table and are not boosted by C5), authored for the field's 9s duration. Same caveats as E: target 'active', 2s off-field linger not modeled.

Crystal Collapse authored as summonTick damage on General's Glory: every 1.5s (kit text), 110.34% DEF at burst talent level 10, Geo, single opponent (KQM TCL). A4 adds +15.6% DEF flat per tick — carried by the existing A4 passive damage effect, intentionally NOT duplicated as flatScaling here.

C2 extends General's Glory duration by 1s per Crystallize shard pickup (once per 0.1s, max +3s per cast). This is event-driven (subscribes to OnShielded + Crystallize shield type check), not a flat constellation durationModifier — not modeled here. Reviewer to decide representation.

↻ 9s -> 11s, 2026-09-21 — see the note on Inuzaka All-Round Defense. General's Glory is 9s from the burst's hitmark (gcsim generalGloryDuration = 9*60, with its own comment on why it is not the datamined 9.1) and the tick chain's last 2s mod runs past it.
abilities.description:
Displaying his valor as a general, Gorou deals AoE Geo DMG and creates a field known as General's Glory to embolden his comrades.

General's Glory
This field has the following properties:
· Like the General's War Banner created by Inuzaka All-Round Defense, provides buffs to active characters within the skill's AoE based on the number of Geo characters in the party. Also moves together with your active character.
· Generates 1 Crystal Collapse every 1.5s that deals AoE Geo DMG to 1 opponent within the skill's AoE.
· Pulls 1 elemental shard in the skill's AoE to your active character's position every 1.5s (elemental shards are created by Crystallize reactions).

If a General's War Banner created by Gorou currently exists on the field when this ability is used, it will be destroyed. In addition, for the duration of General's Glory, Gorou's Elemental Skill "Inuzaka All-Round Defense" will not create the General's War Banner.
 If Gorou falls, the effects of General's Glory will be cleared.
abilities.caveat: An E cast while General's Glory is up still draws a banner here; in game none appears until the Glory ends.

passives.description:
Gorou receives the following DMG Bonuses to his attacks based on his DEF:
· Inuzaka All-Round Defense: Skill DMG increased by 156% of DEF
· Juuga: Forward Unto Victory: Skill DMG and Crystal Collapse DMG increased by 15.6% of DEF
_curatorNotes: ↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). Both halves CONVERTED from `damage`/`manual` to the flat-DMG house form (Zhongli "Dominance of Earth", Cyno A2, Dehya A4). They were never damage instances: gcsim `asc.go:28-33` returns `TotalDef × 1.56` and `skill.go:52` uses it as `FlatDmg` on the Inuzaka All-Round Defense hit — his only skill-tagged damage — while `asc.go:38-43` returns `TotalDef × 0.156` and BOTH `burst.go:42` (the initial Juuga hit) and `burst.go:122` (Crystal Collapse) carry it, so the whole burst class takes it. ⚠️ The kit line reads "Juuga: Forward Unto Victory: Skill DMG" for a BURST bonus — that is the burst talent row's own wording; ⛔ do not let a later pass "fix" it to `skillFlatDmg`. ⚠️ Under-claim: General's Glory's Crystal Collapse is authored as a summon `damage` tick, not as burst-class damage, so `burstFlatDmg` does not reach it in our model even though gcsim applies it there. The ascension-4 gate is deliberately unauthored, matching all three exemplars (`DEFAULT_ASCENSION` is 4).

constellations.name: Valiant Hound: Mountainous Fealty
_curatorNotes: C6 authored as three mutually-exclusive geoCritDmg tiers keyed to the banner state at cast: +10% (Standing Firm, 1 Geo → 0 non-Gorou Geo), +20% (Impregnable, = 1), +40% (Crunch, >= 2). trigger.ability omitted intentionally so the buff fires on both E and Q casts (Kazuha-C6 / Escoffier-C1 convention; lint 'trigger-ability-missing' warn acceptable).
Explicit constellation-level-6 condition included: dispatchers gate constellation-node effects via effect conditions, not the node's constellationLevel (Escoffier C1 precedent).

In-game 'cannot stack; takes reference from the last instance triggered' — overlapping E and Q windows render as separate 12s bars; last-cast-wins replacement is not modeled. Element-specific crit stat authored snapshottable: false per Escoffier C1 cryoCritDmg precedent.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — Two overlapping 12s Geo CRIT DMG bars — one on the "Gorou Skill" row and one on the "Gorou Burst" row. `trigger.ability` is deliberately omitted so `collectOnCastEffects` fires the effect for BOTH casts, and `teamBuffRows` keys character cast rows by ability class (`${charId}::char::${AB_LABEL}`), so the two windows land on DIFFERENT rows and the refresh-merge cannot collapse them. In game the buff explicitly "cannot stack and takes reference from the last instance" — one bar, refreshed. Two bars read as two instances. Category: visible-divergence.

↻ CAVEAT RESTORED 2026-09-17 (T1.5, essential-characters §3): the removal above filed its own pixel as `visible-divergence` — two overlapping bars on two rows where the game has one refreshed instance — so it fails the ruthless pass's own test rather than passing it.
constellations.description:
For 12s after using Inuzaka All-Round Defense or Juuga: Forward Unto Victory, increases the CRIT DMG of all nearby party members' Geo DMG based on the buff level of the skill's field at the time of use:
· "Standing Firm": +10%
· "Impregnable": +20%
· "Crunch": +40%

This effect cannot stack and will take reference from the last instance of the effect that is triggered.
constellations.caveat: Each cast draws its own bar, on the Skill and Burst rows. In game the buff does not stack, and only the latest instance applies.
